desc: Morning is a little brighter with Very Berry Cheerios Cereal. Flavored with real fruit and other natural flavors, the goodness of Cheerios shines through. Every delicious serving brings the taste of strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries to America's favorite Os for a breakfast cereal that's so berry good, you may pour a bowlful every morning. Pass this sweetened whole grain oat cereal around the family table. Pour a bagful for gluten free snacks to take on the go. Or use the little Os to make berry cereal bars and kids snacks. Cheerios are also great gluten free snacks for kids. Each O is made with no artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources. Every serving of this gluten free cereal has a good source of calcium, plus 12 vitamins and minerals, and 21g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily). Very Berry Cheerios cereal can help lower cholesterol* as part of a heart healthy diet. *Three grams of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, like Very Berry Cheerios Cereal, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease. Very Berry Cheerios provides .75 grams per serving. Store this heart healthy cereal box in your pantry for an easy part of breakfast. Whether you're looking for heart healthy snacks, trail mix ingredients, or a gluten free breakfast addition for the whole family, General Mills cereals spread goodness from tots to grown ups. Contains one cardboard box of crunchy Very Berry Cheerios, Heart Healthy Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, Family Size, 18.6 oz; perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
